name: postgresql-workbench
description: PostgreSQL development workbench for VS Code with SQL scratchpads, schema exploration, testing, coverage, and PL/pgSQL debugging

scripts.build: npm run build:dap && npm --prefix vscode-extension run compile && npm run build:ext
scripts.check: node scripts/check-issue-templates.mjs && biome check packages/ vscode-extension/src/ vscode-extension/acceptance/ vscode-extension/playwright.acceptance.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.bootstrap.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.schema-sync.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.vscode.config.ts e2e/ site/ scripts/build-site.mjs scripts/dev-site.mjs scripts/build-dap-package.mjs scripts/verify-dap-package.mjs scripts/test-dap-package.mjs scripts/create-issue.mjs scripts/check-issue-templates.mjs scripts/issue-workflow.mjs scripts/workbench-index-benchmark.mjs scripts/workbench-index-benchmark.test.mjs
scripts.check:fix: node scripts/check-issue-templates.mjs && biome check --write packages/ vscode-extension/src/ vscode-extension/acceptance/ vscode-extension/playwright.acceptance.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.bootstrap.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.schema-sync.config.ts vscode-extension/playwright.vscode.config.ts e2e/ site/ scripts/build-site.mjs scripts/dev-site.mjs scripts/build-dap-package.mjs scripts/verify-dap-package.mjs scripts/test-dap-package.mjs scripts/create-issue.mjs scripts/check-issue-templates.mjs scripts/issue-workflow.mjs scripts/workbench-index-benchmark.mjs scripts/workbench-index-benchmark.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:run: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/ --exclude e2e/legacy-compat.test.ts --exclude '.worktrees/**' --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:dap: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/e2e.test.ts e2e/debug-lifecycle.test.ts e2e/syntax-consumers.test.ts --exclude '.worktrees/**' --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:lifecycle: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/debug-lifecycle.test.ts --exclude '.worktrees/**' --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:up: cd e2e && docker compose -f docker-compose.legacy.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:run: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/legacy-compat.test.ts --exclude '.worktrees/**' --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:down: cd e2e && docker compose -f docker-compose.legacy.yml down -v
